title: Short-Sale Locate and SSR Checker
description: Deterministic locate-documentation and SSR-flag classification over caller-declared synthetic inputs. locate_satisfied follows the declared on-list flag under a declared source and date; ssr_restriction passes the declared SSR price-test flag through verbatim (the price test itself belongs to the caller's feeds); overall resolves to LOCATE_MISSING, SSR_RESTRICTED, or LOCATE_DOCUMENTED. Pairs with T372 (buy-in scope classifier) when no locate is documented. No borrow lists, no SSR tapes, no cutoff feeds, no registers, no network, no clock.

side.description: This checker classifies short-sale locates only.

on_list.description: Declared on-list flag; locate_satisfied follows it.

ssr_active.description: Declared pass-through of the caller price-test flag.

locate_satisfied.description: True when the declared locate lists the symbol; null on the fail-closed path.

ssr_restriction.description: Verbatim pass-through of the declared ssr_active flag; null on the fail-closed path.

note.description: Deterministic note recording the declared inputs, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

overall.description: LOCATE_MISSING, SSR_RESTRICTED, or LOCATE_DOCUMENTED; null on the fail-closed path.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_short_sale_locate_ssr_checker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classifies a declared short-sale order against declared locate documentation (source, list date, on-list flag) and carries the caller-declared SSR price-test flag verbatim; overall resolves to LOCATE_MISSING, SSR_RESTRICTED, or LOCATE_DOCUMENTED. Checker of caller-declared synthetic inputs only: no borrow lists, no SSR tapes, no cutoff feeds, no registers, no advice.

order.description: declared order: side (sell_short), qty (positive whole shares), symbol

locate.description: declared locate documentation: source, list_date (YYYY-MM-DD), on_list

ssr_active.description: declared pass-through of the caller price-test flag

source: authored by SHORTSALE-LOCATE-BUILD-1 per SHORTSALE-LOCATE-BUILD-SPEC.md. Advice-perimeter positioning: a checker of declared-input arithmetic, not compliance advice, not a recommendation to borrow, locate, cover, or trade, and not connected to any live borrow list, SSR tape, cutoff feed, or register; a declared on-list flag is documentation the caller asserts, never a fact this tool verified; absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired.
